market_context: The 6-18 month structural setup for small-cap momentum is the most favorable since 2016 — earnings broadening, 25-year relative valuation discount, institutional rotation accelerating — but the Iran conflict (Strait of Hormuz effectively closed, oil $100+), a Fed trapped between rising CPI and collapsing payrolls (-92K February), and midterm election headwinds create a SELECTIVE regime requiring quality filters and thematic alignment. Three of six structural forces (defence, nuclear, biotech capital cycle) are READY for deployment; the remaining three require patience.
